datasets.name: VisDrone Benchmark Dataset
datasets.relevanceToIBVAP: Crucial benchmark for high-angle mast, watchtower, and pole-mounted CCTV angles typical of border outposts. Evaluates small-object detection under high-altitude oblique viewpoints where subjects appear small (20-40px).

datasets.name: BDD100K Diverse Driving Video Dataset
datasets.relevanceToIBVAP: Evaluates vehicle detection and multi-object tracking across diverse adverse environmental conditions, including rain, dense fog, night glare, and dawn/dusk transitions representative of Himalayan and Terai border roads.

datasets.name: UFPR-ALPR License Plate Dataset
datasets.relevanceToIBVAP: Provides real-world multi-frame vehicle video tracks specifically recorded at barrier gates and inspection corridors. Validates multi-frame temporal consistency where single-frame OCR is error-prone.

datasets.name: OpenStreetMap Border Topography & GIS
datasets.relevanceToIBVAP: Supplies open geospatial coordinates for Border Outposts, transit check posts, access roads, and international boundary zero-line coordinates for tactical C2 GIS display.
